responsibility: Declares the public interface and key format constants for GCC’s dbx/stabs debug emitter. The header exposes symbol, parameter, register-parameter, and block-symbol output routines from dbxout.c, helper entry points for constructing low-level stab records and values when dbx or XCOFF debugging is enabled, default constructor/destructor set emitters for stabs targets, and the N_SO language-code constants used to tag source language in stab entries.
same_name_distinction: Declares the public entry points and format constants for the dbx/stabs backend, including helpers that xcoffout.c and other code call. Unlike dbxout.c, it does not generate stab records itself; it is the interface/constant definition layer for that implementation.
